reviews.title: It used to work well….
reviews.text: I have been using it for over a year. While it worked well at the start it appears to have developed some issues / glitches, the result being that it has lost some functionality. When I try to reset it now, even after removing and reloading the app, the app repeatedly crashes. Do not purchase the app or subscription until the issues have been resolved.

reviews.title: Not Supported Anymore?
reviews.text: The tracker itself is good and helpful, but the app is starting to have the weird bugs that are tells for a lack of developer support. For instance, you can not delete or deactivate  habits. If you click on the buttons, a dialogue box seems to open at the top of the screen. But attempting to scroll up to the box removes it. That seems small but it’s actually breaks the app since you can’t manage which habits you’re tracking.  I’m sure iOS pushed some change that broke something and there’s some small fix but nobody is looking anymore. So, skip this one

reviews.title: Can’t delete success habit
reviews.text: I have used HabitBull for at least 3 to 4 years the new version has a flaw: it won’t let me delete habits that is successful.
